$comment: Coldline Task 3.8 public answer contract. Two commit identities and two observed build versions from the student's own rollout and revert, the dotted desired-state keys one drift check reported, the worker replica count and restart policy committed at HEAD, and a structured comparison of four platforms. The GitOps contract checks compare the commits and the worker settings with the branch history, the committed desired state, and the running stack; the protected check compares the observed versions and the platform enumerations with the answer key. There is no self-attestation field, no pass boolean, and no recording URL.
title: Coldline Task 3.8 answers
description: Rollout and rollback commits, observed versions, reported drift, committed worker settings, and the platform comparison.

answers.description: The only top-level answer mapping accepted by the public verifier.

rollout_commit.description: The full 40-character SHA of the commit that changed release_tag to the candidate, from your own branch.

rollout_observed_version.description: The build_version the first probe reported in the poe reconcile record for the rollout commit.

drift_fields.description: Every dotted desired-state key the first poe reconcile-check reported in Step 2.

rollback_commit.description: The full 40-character SHA of the revert commit, from your own branch.

rollback_observed_version.description: The build_version the first probe reported in the poe reconcile record for the revert commit.

worker_replicas.description: The worker replica count committed at HEAD and listed by docker compose ps.

worker_restart_policy.description: The worker restart policy committed at HEAD and reported by docker inspect on each worker container.

platform_comparison.description: One entry per platform, every enumerated field from its allowed values, and a note in Elena's terms.

recommendation.description: Which platform gives Elena the loop as she described it, which would need the team to bring it, and one limit of what the Compose run proves.

desired_state_source.description: Where the platform itself reads the desired state from.

drift_correction.description: Whether the platform corrects drift by itself, only on a command, or not at all.

rollback_by.description: How a rollback is expressed on this platform.

note.description: What this answer means for on-call and the dispatch floor.
